mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, indicates a growing demand for housing and, by extension, a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, below 2% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, above 4% indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE is above 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, indicates a growing supply of goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, and a decrease in the unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, indicate a growing demand for goods and services and a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high retail sales and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, and an increase in the money supply, as measured by CPIAUCSL, indicate an expansionary monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low federal funds rate and high money supply (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment, as measured by PAYEMS, and a decrease in the unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high payroll employment and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP, as measured by GDPC1, indicates a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high GDP and monetary easing (t-test p > 0.05).
